text: At least 130 place cards across landmark, park, food, wildlife, history, culture, hidden and transit, each discoverable, placed in one of the 41 DataSF neighborhoods.
Trivia asks a 4-option question from its card at the place; the right answer completes, a wrong answer or timeout fails and reveals the answer; at least 70 trivia activities.
Guided tours visit 4 to 6 stops in order with narration at each stop and a waypoint to the next; at least 14 tours.
